name: Ferienhof Hinterleiten
beschreibung:
Quietly perched on a sunny slope near Lake Walchsee, Ferienhof Hinterleiten welcomes visitors with authentic Tyrolean farmstead charm. Its cosy apartments feature natural timber finishes and balconies overlooking the Kaiser mountains.

Children love interacting with the farm animals and playing in the garden, while the lake invites swimming and the surrounding peaks beckon for hiking and skiing.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienhof Hinterleiten in Walchsee offers an authentic family farm holiday with sweeping panoramic views in Kaiserwinkl.
